description: This file defines the interface for a simplistic FIFO queue implementation in C, including data structures, function prototypes for creating, destroying, manipulating, and iterating over the queue, as well as function pointer types for item management and comparison.

methods.name: queueDestroy
methods.description: Destroys a queue and releases associated memory, optionally freeing items with a custom function.

methods.name: queueCount
methods.description: Returns the number of elements in the queue.

methods.name: queuePush
methods.description: Appends an item to the end of the queue.

methods.name: queuePop
methods.description: Removes and returns the next item from the queue.

methods.name: queueDelete
methods.description: Deletes a specific item from the queue based on a comparison function.

methods.name: queueFind
methods.description: Finds an item in the queue based on a comparison function.

methods.name: queueIterate
methods.description: Iterates over each item in the queue, calling a callback function.

methods.name: queueClear
methods.description: Clears all items from the queue, optionally freeing items with a custom function.
